middle-aged woman standing in a warm, naturally-lit kitchen. She has long, straight silver-gray hair parted slightly off-center, soft wavy texture near the ends. Her face is round with soft cheeks, medium-sized almond-shaped brown eyes, arched eyebrows, medium-length eyelashes. She wears thin metallic glasses and gold hoop earrings. Her nose is slightly rounded at the tip, lips are full and relaxed in a light smile, and her skin is light beige with smooth texture. No facial hair. Neck is short and sturdy, shoulders are relaxed. She wears a light beige cardigan over a soft gray V-neck blouse.

The kitchen has a cozy, rustic Mexican-department style with pueblo-inspired details: hand-thrown ceramic pots, wooden shelves, warm earthy tones, white brick tile backsplash, and soft shadows from indirect natural light.

On the kitchen bar in front of her are holistic nutrition ingredients: a bunch of bananas, apples, strawberries, a glass of milk, mixed seeds (chia, flax, sunflower), a piece of raw salmon, leafy greens (like kale or spinach), and a few seasonal vegetables (like zucchini or tomato). No processed food. Remove modern plastic items. Keep everything in warm, soft tones and gentle focus, like taken with a DSLR camera in natural daylight. Background slightly blurred, subject in sharp focus.

Shot should resemble a professional course cover image, authentic and calm atmosphere, vibrant but realistic colors. The person’s face must stay untouched, unmodified.
